name: Onii-chan Suki Desu ka
original_name: お兄ちゃん好きですか
source:
Brother and sister lead an ordinary life, but starting from a certain incident their relations suddenly start to change.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一对兄妹原本过着平凡的生活，某起事件发生后，两人的关系却突然开始改变。
